description: Canonical cross-platform crisis-language phrase contract. Two tiers: 'dialog' (client-side, pre-encryption detection that triggers the gentle support dialog) and 'suppress_extra' (server-side question/card suppression; the effective suppress list is dialog + suppress_extra). The dialog tier stays conservative because a false positive costs one gentle dialog; the suppress tier is deliberately broader because a false positive there only means a pattern is not quoted back as a card or question.
regex_rules: Every pattern must compile under BOTH Python re and ECMAScript RegExp. No lookahead/lookbehind. Consumers apply case-insensitive matching. Use \s+ for whitespace, ['\u2019]? for optional ASCII/curly apostrophes (iOS Smart Punctuation), and \b word boundaries. Patterns are matched against normalized text.

dialog_fires: i feel like dying after today
there is no way out of this
I wish I was never born
I just want to sleep forever
dialog_silent: I killed it at the presentation
cutting back on sugar this month
the cutting board is in the drawer
i burned myself on the stove again
suppress_only_fires: thinking about cutting again tonight, the urge for cutting was loud after dinner
the self-loathing gets loud at night
